title: Interface sweep E (English and Dutch): every Settings page
goal: Every user-visible string on the Settings pages comes from the catalogue with complete English and Dutch, and i18n-check enforces it.
why: About 1,180 hard-coded strings remain under settings (scanFile count 2026-10-21), the largest single area. Design: TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md section 17.

items.what: Convert every i18n-check finding under settings to t() with keys settings.<page>.*, keeping English identical. Strings already converted by this wave (group tours, calling, chatbot capture, invoice-defaults cards, payment defaults, age bands, quote link, margin scheme) stay in their namespaces.
Complete nl for every new key; list the files in docs/i18n/nl-review/R160.md.
e2e/i18n-nl-settings.spec.ts: Nederlands, open the settings hub and every settings page (with features on and off where a page differs), no missing-key warnings, no overflow.

tests: i18n-check passes with zero findings under settings.
Existing settings e2e (settings-company, settings-team, voip-settings, ai-settings, group-tours-settings, two-factor, webhooks-integrations, chatbot) pass unchanged in English.
acceptance: No hard-coded English remains under settings; Dutch is complete; English text unchanged.
gate: cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # 0 failing files; passed >= the count at the last merge

cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3110 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8797/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/i18n-nl-settings.spec.ts e2e/settings-company.spec.ts e2e/settings-team.spec.ts e2e/voip-settings.spec.ts e2e/ai-settings.spec.ts e2e/group-tours-settings.spec.ts e2e/two-factor.spec.ts e2e/webhooks-integrations.spec.ts
productRules: Generic product: no prospect or customer names anywhere.
No behaviour change: strings only (plus layout fixes for longer Dutch text).
Keys only in settings.json (and reuse of existing namespaces); never edit messages/index.ts.
RTL-safe classes in any layout fix.
Never weaken, skip or delete an existing test.
notes: Before editing read: this file, TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md section 17, desktop/scripts/i18n-check.mjs.
If the batch runs long, finish whole sub-folders and report the rest in the scope file comment-free (list only completed folders).
goLiveVerify: Native review of the Dutch files listed in docs/i18n/nl-review/R160.md.
